scope: CK-001 prototype and pilot screening. Project-selected targets, not external certification or a production reliability demonstration.
condition_note: Do not force a factory switch past its own hard stop. Confirm its measured stroke is inside the manufacturer's 2.8..3.2 mm range; inspect clearance at that actual stop. A separate unloaded geometry fixture covers the 3.2 mm design envelope.

metrics.description: Minimum physical boss-to-housing clearance after measuring the selected factory switch, including its unmodeled dust structure.
Actual full stroke to the factory stop with no premature contact introduced by the cap.
Peak controlled installation force for the selected receiver/material; stop if interference or damage is seen.
Initial axial pull-off force. This project window balances retention with service removal; it is not a Gateron specification.
Pull-off force on the same five specimens after repeated installation/removal.
Permanent axial slip under the specified pull with the actual set screw, shaft and knob.
Relative shaft/knob rotation under a torsional hold.

Destructively measured first joint-failure torque divided by the proposed assembly torque. Identify thread stripping, screw fracture, base pull-through or post fracture explicitly. This is the limiting joint strength, not necessarily thread strip strength. Attach torque curves; the frozen configuration sets the screw manufacturer's maximum.
Permanent carrier shift after axial loading through the mounted encoder; inspect the countersunk base and posts for damage.
Largest permanent movement after loads in each principal direction. Record all directions in the raw report.
Incomplete returns or sticking in full-stroke guide cycles, including offset spacebar presses.
Maximum lateral free play after the guide screening cycles, using intended material and pin finish.
Maximum input current including startup before successful enumeration, across cable orientations and the input-voltage range.
Maximum configured input current with the supported all-white RGB pattern, all controls scanned and worst intended voltage/temperature.
Hottest touchable surface after full-load thermal settling. Internal component junction limits require separate engineering checks.
Missing, duplicate or ghost key events and encoder steps in a logged test covering all 58 keys and all five encoders, both directions.

limitations: The listed sample counts screen a pilot build; they do not prove mass-production yield or long-term field reliability.
File hashes and a physical-origin declaration do not authenticate a laboratory or an operator. Raw records and calibration certificates must be independently reviewable.
Passing these metrics cannot compensate for an incomplete factory interface, schematic, routed PCB or target firmware.
The 100/500 mA targets do not establish USB compliance, inrush, suspend/resume or signal-integrity certification. These remain explicit board-validation work.
No measured value exists until an actual specimen and test are recorded. Empty forms are not passed tests.
